verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents broad programmatic coverage of admin-console functions. The Admin SDK covers SSO and email routing settings, alerts, Chrome device management, user listing and provisioning, and audit and usage reports, and Apps Script automates Admin console tasks. However, the evidence never claims or shows full API–UI parity, and it covers only the admin surface. missing for 10: an explicit statement or verification of API/UI parity, evidence of API coverage for end-user app features (Gmail, Docs, Meet settings such as 'Take notes for me', Context-Aware Access policies), and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Anyone can use Apps Script to automate Admin console tasks in a web-based, low-code environment.
Manage single sign-on (SSO) and email routing settings for your account.
View and manage Google Workspace alerts for your account.
Manage Chrome Browser devices for your account.
Retrieves a paginated list of either deleted users or all users in a domain.
The Admin SDK Reports API lets administrators of enterprise domains to view the audit and usage reports of their domain.
Cloud Identity API is an API for provisioning and managing identity resources.
